title: Fix production kustomize apply drift
description:
Kubectl apply for production overlay fails on GKE due to selector immutability and caddy port drift.

Errors observed:
- Deployments: selector immutable when apply tries to add or remove environment label.
- Service caddy: spec.ports[1].name required (likely mismatch with live http3 port plus last-applied state).

Goal:
- Make production overlay apply cleanly without touching selectors (labels transformer with includeSelectors false or remove env label),
- Reconcile caddy service ports to match live service (http/https/http3),
- Avoid deleting PVCs or scaling DB workloads to 0.

Acceptance:
- kubectl apply -k deploy/k8s/overlays/production succeeds on GKE,
- No selector immutability errors,
- Caddy service update applies cleanly.
